title: Would you like to speak at the OpenStack Summit?
description: Archived call for presentations for the San Diego 2012 OpenStack Summit, preserving the historical submission deadline and agenda-planning dates.
body: Just a few days left to submit a presentation for the OpenStack Summit. The deadline for speaker submissions is August 30, 2012, and we will open up the voting system early September, with the goal of locking the "Conference" portion of the agenda by September 17. You can summit your presentation topic on the Call For Speakers Page.
seoTitle: OpenStack Summit San Diego 2012 — Would you like to speak at the OpenStack Summit?
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
